LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 3.1.1 LISTENING FOR COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, part of Strand 3 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do you use pronouns in communication? 2. How do we ensure we are safe when using vehicles?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a story or passage (on safe ways of boarding and alighting, use of seat belts) from a digital device and identify pronouns,

2. work jointly to fill gaps in sentences using pronouns in singular and plural forms,

3. listen to a story or passage on Road Safety and create a vocabulary bank of thematic words used,

4. play language games using cards to match vocabulary to their meaning,

5. make sentences using the vocabulary identified and share for review, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a story or passage (on safe ways of boarding and alighting, use of seat belts) from a digital device and identify pronouns,
2. work jointly to fill gaps in sentences using pronouns in singular and plural forms,
3. listen to a story or passage on Road Safety and create a vocabulary bank of thematic words used,
4. play language games using cards to match vocabulary to their meaning,
5. make sentences using the vocabulary identified and share for review, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner engages actively when role playing a scene on road

safety.

• Citizenship: This is enhanced as the learner accumulates information on the theme when listening to a story from a digital

device.

Values:
• Love: This is enhanced as the learner displays trustworthiness when sharing their sentences with peers for review.

• Social justice: This is promoted as the learner gives peers an equal chance to participate in pronoun games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and security: This is developed as the learner is exposed to content on road safety.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept on pronouns to their learning of parts of speech in English and Kiswahili.
